title: Recursive Sketched Interpolation: Efficient Hadamard Products of Tensor Trains
summary: The Hadamard product of two tensors in the tensor-train (TT) format is a fundamental operation across various applications, such as TT-based function multiplication for nonlinear differential equations or convolutions. However, conventional methods for computing this product typically scale as at least $\mathcal{O}(χ^4)$ with respect to the TT bond dimension (TT-rank) $χ$, creating a severe computational bottleneck in practice.
